title: JavaScript for Frontend Development Mastery
description: Learn JavaScript deeply enough that frontend frameworks never hide gaps in the underlying language — covering the type system, functions, closures, objects, classes, asynchronous programming, the DOM, and enough Node/npm to work with modern frontend tooling.

nodes.label: JavaScript Orientation
nodes.description: Understand JavaScript as a language distinct from the browser and Node.js environments that provide APIs around it, and how JavaScript, HTML, and CSS divide responsibility for behavior, structure, and presentation.

nodes.label: Variables & Types
nodes.description: Declare variables with const/let/var, distinguish statements from expressions, and reason about JavaScript's primitive types, dynamic typing, type coercion, and truthy/falsy evaluation — including well-known quirks like typeof null and NaN.

nodes.label: Control Flow

nodes.label: Scope & Closures

nodes.label: Objects & Destructuring

nodes.label: Maps, Sets & Data Modeling

nodes.label: Async Fundamentals
